title: e2e response recorder can drop bodies still in flight when a gate ends
notes: test/e2e/conform.mjs appends a response only after response.text() resolves, and returns silently on error. If the browser context closes before a body is read, that response is never checked, so the gate can pass without holding it to the schema. Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
